react.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
react.content: ReAct interleaves reasoning traces with task-specific actions. Environment observations update subsequent reasoning and action plans. The paper evaluates HotpotQA, FEVER and interactive decision tasks. It improves interpretability, while prompting examples and occasional non-informative reasoning remain limitations. Evidence locator: arXiv 2210.03629, Sections 3-4.

reflexion.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
reflexion.content: Reflexion converts task feedback into verbal reflections and stores them in episodic memory for later trials without updating model weights. It evaluates decision-making, reasoning and programming tasks. Results depend on evaluator feedback, prompts, memory window, model version and environment setup. Evidence locator: arXiv 2303.11366, Sections 2-4.

rag.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
rag.content: RAG combines a pretrained parametric generator with non-parametric dense retrieval over Wikipedia. The retrieved passages condition generation and can provide provenance. The paper studies sequence-level and token-level variants on knowledge-intensive tasks. Evidence locator: arXiv 2005.11401, Sections 2-4.

graphrag.title: From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
graphrag.content: GraphRAG builds an entity knowledge graph and hierarchical community summaries, then uses community reports to answer global questions over a corpus. It targets questions that ordinary chunk retrieval handles poorly, while graph extraction and summarization add indexing cost. Evidence locator: arXiv 2404.16130, Sections 2-3.
